profile.name: kanywst
profile.tagline: Identity, Authorization, and Cloud Native Security.

flagships.name: wtfi2
flagships.tagline: Live, visual network-path diagnostic that pinpoints exactly where your Wi-Fi connection dies — and how to fix it. Rust + ratatui TUI.

flagships.name: y509
flagships.tagline: A terminal UI for viewing and analyzing X.509 certificate chains.

flagships.name: a2acode
flagships.tagline: Serve any ACP coding agent — Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex — over the A2A protocol, keeping tool progress, file diffs and permission prompts intact.

flagships.name: awesome-authorization
flagships.tagline: Curated authorization & access-control tools, frameworks, standards, and resources.

flagships.name: opa-authzen-plugin
flagships.tagline: Extended OPA implementing the OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 Authorization API.

flagships.name: hammurabi
flagships.tagline: Engineering laws and mental models, each paired with its counter-force, a field guideline, and a primary source.

flagships.name: omega
flagships.tagline: SPIFFE workload identity + OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 authorization in a single binary: Cedar PDP, federation, tamper-evident audit log, Kubernetes operator.

flagships.name: wimsey
flagships.tagline: Vendor-neutral WIMSE workload-identity reference implementation: WIT/WPT tokens, RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures, mTLS/WIC.

flagships.name: howbad
flagships.tagline: If a coding agent on your machine got prompt-injected right now, how bad would it be? Finds the credentials it could use and asks each provider what they can do.

flagships.name: mcp-opa-authz
flagships.tagline: MCP server giving LLM agents real authorization answers: evaluate Rego in-process via OPA, or ask an OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 PDP

flagships.name: visado
flagships.tagline: Verify AI agent delegation chains and workload credentials at the enforcement point, ask an AuthZEN PDP, and pass the result downstream as an OAuth Transaction Token.

org.name: 0-draft
org.blurb: Research & incubation org: source-checked visual explainers, reference implementations and deep dives across identity, authorization and security.

repos.name: how-chat-apps-work
repos.blurb: How a chat message travels from send to read receipt, step by step: persistent connections, ACKs and idempotent retries, push notifications, E2EE, group fan-out. Interactive sequence diagrams in English and Japanese.

repos.name: wtfe2
repos.blurb: WTF, Engineer? — comics about building software, lettered in Japanese where the license allows

repos.name: zanzibar-paper
repos.blurb: The Zanzibar paper (USENIX ATC '19) side by side with translations in 8 languages, paragraph by paragraph.

repos.name: claude-english-coach
repos.blurb: A template repo for learning English with Claude Code: corrections, a mistake log, vocab and quizzes in plain Markdown.

repos.name: why-hackers-dont-get-caught
repos.blurb: Why hackers don't get caught: how attackers hide, layer by layer, why so many named attackers stay out of reach, and the one layer that gave away those who were caught. Visual explainer, EN/JA, every claim sourced.

repos.name: ccretro
repos.blurb: A retrospective of your Claude Code usage as a local web page — period comparison, follow-through on last month's suggestions, and a /ccretro skill that turns them into skills, hooks and CLAUDE.md

repos.name: vpn-is-the-door
repos.blurb: Why VPN appliances are the main way ransomware gets into Japanese organizations (61 of 92 known entry routes in 2025, NPA): statistics, real cases, 31 exploited VPN flaws. EN / 日本語.

repos.name: goi
repos.blurb: A route map of Japanese words worth using: idioms, proverbs and four-character compounds, each with its meaning, origin, an example and sources. English and Japanese.

repos.name: php2shell-anatomy
repos.blurb: Defensive awareness site dissecting the php2shell PHP zero-day (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619): why it's critical, who's affected, and how to patch in time.

repos.name: aws-credentials
repos.blurb: AWS credentials, drawn: how they are issued (every STS endpoint, all 11 APIs, every credential path) and how requests are signed with them (SigV4, SigV4a, presigned URLs). Interactive, bilingual (EN/JA).

repos.name: aws-connectivity
repos.blurb: Every way from a corporate network into AWS, drawn as a road map (VPN, Direct Connect, SD-WAN, hubs, PrivateLink, hybrid DNS), plus a Direct Connect deep dive with labs. Bilingual (EN/JA).

repos.name: s3-atlas
repos.blurb: Everything about Amazon S3 — deep research docs, command cookbook, competitor and market analysis, and an interactive visual atlas (EN/JA).

repos.name: casino
repos.blurb: Blackjack and baccarat played by whoever turns up. Every decision or bet is a GitHub issue and both tables are the README.

repos.name: authz-playground
repos.blurb: Give Cedar, OPA/Rego, Casbin and ReBAC the same authorization rules, then watch where their answers diverge. Runs entirely in the browser.

repos.name: identity-deep-dive
repos.blurb: Collect and score deep-dive candidates across the OAuth, WIMSE and digital-credentials working groups.
